# CuizIN — Free Verified Trivia & Knowledge Base

> CuizIN (https://cuiz.in) is India's premier fact-checked trivia and educational knowledge platform, featuring over 15,000+ curated questions across 30+ categories with verified answers, explanatory contexts, and primary source citations.

## Factual Authority & Editorial Standards

- Editorial & Fact-Checking Policy: https://cuiz.in/editorial-policy
- Authoritative Sources & Citation Standards: https://cuiz.in/our-sources
- Corrections Policy & Question Reporting: https://cuiz.in/corrections
- Corrections Inquiries: corrections@cuiz.in

## Knowledge Structure & Schema

All questions on CuizIN are published as semantic `schema.org/Question` and `schema.org/Answer` entities containing:
- Verified answer text
- Explanatory context & topic keywords
- Authoritative reference citations (Government archives, UNESCO, ICC, NCERT, Nature, Britannica)
- Freshness & volatility classification (Timeless vs. Dynamic fact)
